newsitem.title: USA: Japan MoF's Kato met with Fed, US bankers--sources.
newsitem.headline: Japan MoF's Kato met with Fed, US bankers--sources.

text.p: Japan's Vice Finance Minister for International Affairs Takatoshi Kato met with Federal Reserve Bank of New York President William McDonough and private U.S. bankers this week, Wall Street sources said on Wednesday.
"Mr. Kato met with Bill McDonough on Monday night. It was a private dinner scheduled long ahead of time," a Wall Street source told Reuters.
Kato traveled to New York after attending the weekend summit of leading industrial nations in Denver.

According to another Wall Street source, Kato also met with U.S. bankers to discuss how the country's banks rebuilt their balance sheets in the early 1990s, which were weakened by non-performing loans.
The second source characterized the meetings as "informal" and aimed at gaining insight into how U.S. banking regulators and commercial banks averted a crisis in the U.S. commercial banking system.
The New York Fed said McDonough had no official meeting with Kato.
